text:
alex: FYI ran the sprint probe for BlueOak today, pushing mixed workload (chat + embed) to emulate their prod mix. quick notes below.

maria: awesome — can you drop the config and the headline numbers?

alex: config: model=llama-2-13b-8k-quant, deploy=dedicated (2xA100), concurrency target=120 concurrent reqs, batch_target=16, kv_cache=enabled, prefix_cache=on for repeated prompts. test runner=k6 + custom client sim.

ryan: how did you mix chat vs embed? they asked for 70/30 right?
alex: 70% chat (avg tokens out=220), 30% embeddings (text-embedding-3-small). traffic profile: poisson arrival, peak sustained qps=95, short microbursts ~230 qps for 30s every 10m.

alex: results (30m steady-state):
- sustained throughput: 95 qps achieved with 95% success
- p50 latency (chat gen): 85ms per token, end-to-end p50 request = 310ms
- p95 latency (chat gen): 740ms end-to-end (includes tail during bursts)
- embeddings p95: 180ms
- observed GPU util: 72% avg, memory headroom ~8GB
- cost estimate (hosted-equivalent): ~ $0.62 / 1k chat tokens when run on dedicated pool + amortized infra (very rough)

maria: p95 740ms — is that within the SLA we promised? BlueOak asked for <500ms p95 for interactive flows.

alex: not quite. Most of the tail is due to microburst queueing at the gateway + some cold kv-cache misses at the start of bursts. If we tweak batch_target down to 12 and enable aggressive prefix-cache priming we can get p95 ~480ms in a follow-up run.

samira: can we call that mitigation low-effort before we pass to eng-infra? timeline?

ryan: sounds reasonable. steps: 1) enable prefix prewarm for their top-100 prompts 2) lower batch target to 12 during bursts 3) enable short-lived extra worker (burst capacity) to absorb the 30s spikes. ops-bot: deploy suggestion created: RB-#5234.

ops-bot: [automated] rollout-suggestion RB-#5234 created by alex. includes autoscale policy: +1 worker when 1m avg qps >120, cooldown 3m. link: https://console.redwood.example/rb/5234

alex: added a short k6 snippet we used for the chat runner:

```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';

export default function () {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({
    model: 'llama-2-13b-8k-quant',
    prompt: 'Summarize the user message',
    max_tokens: 256
  });
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', payload, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer XXX' } });
  sleep(Math.random() * 0.2);
}
```

maria: can you add the versioned config we tested so sales can include it in the proposal? they want the delta vs our standard Dedicated sku.

alex: sure — config blob (short): instance=dedicated-2xA100, model_variant=13b-8k-quant-v2, batching=batch_target=16 (test), prewarm=false (test). I'll attach a follow-up with the prewarm-primed run numbers.

samira: security question from BlueOak: they asked about KMS/HSM for model keys and audit logs retention. do we have an ask to legal/infosec?

ryan: call out to eng-security: for Private we can use customer-managed KMS; for Dedicated we can offer envelope encryption and audit export to their SIEM. I'll draft the wording.

alex: immediate next steps:
- run primed-prewarm config (batch_target=12, prewarm top-100 prompts) — ETA 2h
- re-run 30m soak and capture new p95 numbers
- add autoscale suggestion to proposal and update cost delta
- draft security blurb for sales pack

maria: thanks. once you have the updated p95 and cost delta we'll update the quote and the SOW.

ryan: if priming + batch tweak doesn't hit <500ms p95, we escalate to eng-runtime for kernel tuning (likely more dev time).

alex: noted. will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

samira: pinging @mike-infosec for the KMS/audit copy — Mike, can you drop 2-3 lines we can paste into the security questionnaire?

ops-bot: deploy job started (rb-#5234) by alex at 1766667785

alex: quick follow-up (1766667812): ran the prewarm + batch_target=12 experiment (15m run focused on bursts):
- p95 (chat gen) reduced to 495ms — borderline but within negotiation range if BlueOak accepts short warmup windows
- burst drop rate: 0.6% (was 5% before)
- incremental infra cost estimate for autoscale: +$1.7k/mo for reserved pool to cover bursts

maria: great — can you snapshot logs and the CSV perf export? we'll attach to the proposal.

alex: uploading CSV and flame graphs to the deal folder now: https://drive.redwood.example/blueoak/perf/1766667777-report.zip

samira: I'll update the pricing sheet with the +$1.7k/mo and draft the security answers. thanks all.

ryan: nice work. leaving this thread for the SOW update owners.

alex: closing loop here. will update if eng-runtime needs to be pulled in.
